3. Add a rectangular rib on the top face with a width of 10.0, a length of 40.0, and a height of 5.0.
4. Cut a rectangular pocket into the top face measuring 60.0 long by 40.0 wide by 15.0 deep.
5. Drill two through holes of diameter 8.7 spaced 50.0 apart along the length.
6. Drill four counterbored holes of diameter 4.7 with a counterbore diameter of 13.1 and a counterbore depth of 8.0, arranged in a 2 by 3 pattern with 25.0 spacing in both directions.
7. Drill two additional counterbored holes of diameter 4.7 with a counterbore diameter of 11.6 and a counterbore depth of 8.0, positioned at the remaining locations in the pattern.
8. Apply a chamfer of 0.5 to all vertical edges.
